    "Provides a simple, integrated platform for project oversight"

  "cons": [
    "Free plan severely limits to a single project, hindering broader use",
    "Initial setup requires manually adding tools to each project",
    "Calendar events default to specific times rather than all-day deadlines"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This designer and operations manager likely found Basecamp's calendar functional for tracking project deadlines, appreciating its clear interface for managing tasks. However, the limitation of the free plan to a single project was a significant constraint for managing multiple workstreams. They probably encountered some minor friction in the initial setup and event configuration, but the core tools were generally easy to use."
